title: Palolem Beach
description: A crescent-shaped beach with calm waters and colorful wooden huts, perfect for swimming and relaxation. Often referred to as Paradise Beach, Palolem offers gentle waves and stunning sunset views.
time: Best Time: 6:00 AM - 7:00 PM (Best at sunrise or sunset)

title: Agonda Beach
description: A quiet, pristine beach known for its unspoiled beauty and serene atmosphere. Perfect for those seeking tranquility away from the crowds, with opportunities to spot sea turtles during nesting season.
time: Open 24 hours (Best time: Early morning or evening)

title: Cabo de Rama Fort
description: An ancient fort with panoramic views of the Arabian Sea, rich in history and legends. Originally built by local rulers and later expanded by the Portuguese, it offers stunning coastal vistas.

title: Butterfly Beach
description: A hidden cove accessible by boat or trek, famous for its butterfly sightings and dolphin watching. This secluded paradise offers a crescent-shaped golden sand beach surrounded by dense forests.

title: Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary
description: One of Goa's oldest wildlife sanctuaries, home to diverse flora and fauna including rare species like the flying squirrel and slender loris. Features a 25m high treetop watchtower for wildlife observation.

title: Cola Beach
description: A secluded beach with a beautiful freshwater lagoon adjacent to the sea. This hidden gem offers a unique landscape where the blue sea meets the emerald lagoon, creating a perfect spot for photography.
time: Open 24 hours (Best time: Morning for photography)
price: Free entry; Lagoon kayaking: ₹300 per hour
